title: AI bubble? Nvidia is now bigger than Japan, but valuation looks modest
source_used: The Irish Times (full text from the pre-fetched file)
key_facts: Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, set a new record high, ending a 96-trading-day drought; Bespoke Investment says it was shareholders' third-longest wait since ChatGPT's November 2022 launch.
Nvidia was worth $5.8 trillion at its recent peak.
Nvidia now accounts for 5.2 per cent of the MSCI All Country World Index, slightly more than Japan and more than every country except the US.
Taiwan is 3.5 per cent, the UK and Canada 2.9 per cent each; Nvidia's weighting is almost three times Germany's.
Nvidia trades on about 15 times estimated earnings, according to Finviz, cheaper than 295 of the S&P 500's component stocks.
A fortnight ago Nvidia authorised an additional $150 billion share buyback, the largest such authorisation in history.
